entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit Support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I hope you can help me. I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought.
I can certainly look into that return for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I feel terrible about this, I know I've had it for about three weeks now. I'm just so worried it's too late.
Okay, order VF-8675309. I see it was delivered 20 days ago. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. It's just... we had a family emergency right after it arrived. My husband had to be rushed to the hospital for an unexpected surgery. It was all very sudden.
I am so sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay with him now.

He's recovering, thank you. But with everything going on, I completely forgot about dealing with this. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I really needed this money back for some of the bills. I was just hoping there was something you could do.
Please, don't worry about the timing. Your family comes first. Let me just pull up our official return policy for your product. One moment.
Okay, I've got it here. For the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, you are well within the 90-day return window. So, there is absolutely no problem processing this for you.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. I was so stressed about this. That's such a relief, thank you so much.

Of course. I've just initiated that return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account right now. Just pack it back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
That's perfect. You've been a huge help today, Diana. Thank you.
You are very welcome. I wish your husband a speedy recovery. Is there anything else I can help you with?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
